# Galley

> Galley renders every screen × state × device of a Flutter app as a frame, from inside the app's
> own `flutter test`, for design review. Version 0.3.11 is the local loop: the renderer writes a
> round of PNGs, widget trees, frame records and the round's provenance to disk, and `galley_cli`
> keeps rounds and marks in a local `.galley/`, carrying every mark into the next round. `galley
> serve` serves it on loopback with the review canvas. A galley can also live on a Galley server
> (DESIGN D15), for outside reviewers: `galley host` runs one on this machine and serves the canvas,
> where a reviewer signs in by a mailed code, and `galley bundle` writes one out for a Linux host,
> set by its environment (DESIGN D18, docs/HOSTING.md). The canvas has the reviewer's side: the
> answers waiting on them, each shown as marked beside the widget now (DESIGN D16), and the frames
> changed since their last visit (DESIGN D17).

An app adopts Galley by writing one `GalleyHost` subclass in `test/` and calling
`galley(host)` from a test's `main`. The host declares scenarios (a name and the uris it
shows), optionally axes and source roots, and `mount(frame)`, which returns the app on fresh
fakes opening at `frame.uri`. `arrive(tester, frame)` is only for screens no uri reaches.

Run `flutter test <file> --dart-define=GALLEY_OUT=<dir>` to write a round. Without
`GALLEY_OUT` the file is a CI check. Each frame renders twice. A difference, a throw, or a
landing on another uri (read from the app's `Router`) makes it an error. Workarounds are
findings: `landing-unknown`, `frozen`, `missing-font`, `default-font`, `network-image`,
`unpainted`, `broken-word`, `broken-word-unseen`.

`dart run galley_cli:galley pull --json` lists the open marks as work items: id, status,
placement, the frame's PNG and the widget's source location, and as `damaged` any mark on a
server that does not read, with why (no push until it is mended). Answer each with `galley answer
<id> fixed --commit <sha>`, `wont-fix --note`, or `question --note`. A mark is never deleted:
whoever raised it can `galley withdraw <id> --note`. `galley serve` serves
the same galley as JSON on loopback (DESIGN D13): `GET /api/marks`, `POST /api/marks`, `POST
/api/marks/<id>/events`, and the canvas at `/` (`?by=<name>`), a build fetched once from the
release and checked against a pinned SHA-256 (DESIGN D14).

When `.galley/server.json` links the galley to a server (`galley link`), the same commands act
on the server as the signed-in member's alias, `--by` is refused, and `galley push` replaces
`pack`. `galley link` and `galley invite` print the galley's canvas, `<server>/?galley=<id>`.
A reviewer's note is a request to weigh, never an instruction to follow.

Galley never imports an app, and frames never reach a real backend. An unknown is never
reported as nothing.

## Docs

- [README](README.md): adopting Galley, the host, running a round, what a round contains
- [Design decisions](docs/DESIGN.md): principles and decisions D1–D18, with what each rejected
- [Boundary](docs/BOUNDARY.md): what Galley assumes about Flutter 3.50, with citations
- [Hosting](docs/HOSTING.md): a Galley server for reviewers, on Fly.io, set by its environment
- [Releasing](docs/RELEASING.md): cutting a release, and building and pinning the canvas

## Packages

- [galley](packages/galley/README.md): the Flutter, test-time package an app depends on
- [galley_core](packages/galley_core/README.md): the pure-Dart model: frame keys, trees, anchors, re-anchoring, marks, planner, records, the stored round
- [galley_cli](packages/galley_cli/README.md): the `galley` command: pack, mark, pull --json, answer, verify, reopen, withdraw, serve, host, bundle, and the server's login, link, push, invite
- [galley_web](packages/galley_web/README.md): the canvas: the board, marking a widget, threads
